statusHistory.detail: On February 19, 2026, a consortium including Exiro Minerals Corp., Orion Resource Partners LP, and the Canada Growth Fund, alongside Vale Base Metals, announced an investment of up to C$280 million to acquire and revitalize the Thompson Mine Nickel Complex.
